summary: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (CCOI) filed an 8-K announcing its indirect subsidiary Cogent Fiber, LLC entered a definitive agreement to sell 10 data center facilities to an affiliate of I Squared Capital for $225 million cash. The transaction includes related personal property and customer contracts. Closing is subject to HSR approval and expected by the later of June 12, 2026 or following clearance, with a drop-dead date of November 18, 2026. The company guaranteed seller obligations. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory timing and any termination risk before the outside date.
